exercises.q: When will you return the money to me?
exercises.why: **возвратишь** — возврати́ть (perfective): to return, to give back; to recover, to get back. Wiktionary: воз- + -врати́ть.
exercises.context: Which prefix? The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: **возложили** — возложи́ть (perfective): (literary) to lay, to place (something on a certain area for memorial purposes); (literary) to assign (someone with tasks, commands, blames, hopes, or responsibilities). Wiktionary: воз- + ложи́ть.
exercises.context: Which prefix? The English says which word it is.

exercises.q: They put the blame on me.
exercises.why: **возложили** — возложи́ть (perfective): (literary) to lay, to place (something on a certain area for memorial purposes); (literary) to assign (someone with tasks, commands, blames, hopes, or responsibilities). Wiktionary: воз- + ложи́ть.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to think of (doing), to take it into one's head (to), to decide (to)
to object, to mind, to protest
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: взду́мать — to think of (doing), to take it into one's head (to), to decide (to); встрево́жить — to disturb; воскли́кнуть — to exclaim, to cry; возрази́ть — to object, to mind, to protest.
**сделал** — сде́лать (perfective): to make, to do. Wiktionary: с- + де́лать.
exercises.context: Which prefix? The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: **сделал** — сде́лать (perfective): to make, to do. Wiktionary: с- + де́лать.

(intransitive) to revive, to resurrect, to rise from the dead
to ask (to ask a question of)
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: возложи́ть — (literary) to lay, to place (something on a certain area for memorial purposes); воскре́снуть — (intransitive) to revive, to resurrect, to rise from the dead; сде́лать — to make, to do; спроси́ть — to ask (to ask a question of).
